title: Tall whites came in the last ice age to use Earth as a pit stop
summary: Charles Hall tells of Tall whites came in the last ice age to use Earth as a pit stop, about last ice age at Earth / solar system, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Well, they came here in the middle of the last ice age because we for the same reason that we have a base on Guam.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he lived among tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites in the Nevada desert in the 1960s, says they first came to Earth in the middle of the last ice age. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that they came for the same reason the United States has a base on the island of Guam: Earth is a handy stopping point along their way. That would mean Earth is a waypoint for long-distance travellers, not the place they were trying to reach.
